verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents automatic customer notifications triggered by a feature-request status change. The nearby items are adjacent features: changelog announcements of shipped work, manually updating statuses and replying to customers via MCP, syncing statuses with Jira, Linear and others, and team-facing Discord notifications. None of these is the capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can automatically notify customers when the status of their requested feature changes
